name: Card
intro: Build a card with Root and its media, header, title, body, and footer parts. Group multiple cards with Group.

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Lays out a collection of cards. Put each Root inside an li.

props.name: layout
props.description: Places media above, left of, or right of the content.

parts.name: Media
parts.description: Contains an image or other media.

props.name: variant
props.description: Controls how the media meets the card edge.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: Groups the card title and introductory content.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: Styles the card title; place a heading or link inside as needed.

parts.name: Body
parts.description: Put the main card content below Header.
